title: Zesty Smoky Chinese Cobnuts Hot Pot
description: A smoky and chewy Chinese hot pot dish featuring cobnuts, perfect for a family dinner. This keto-friendly recipe is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork belly and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika, soy sauce, and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chopped cobnuts and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until they are caramelized and tender.
Stir in the chopped green onions and sesame oil.
Serve the hot pot hot, with additional soy sauce and sesame oil on the side if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
